brief:
Israel launched attacks on Gaza during nine of every ten days throughout what was described as a ceasefire period, according to Al Jazeera English. The strikes contradicted the stated terms of the truce arrangement and raised questions about the agreement's actual implementation and enforcement.

The pattern of near-daily bombardment occurred during the purported year-long ceasefire. Details about what triggered the individual strikes and how each side characterized the violations remained unclear.
dek: Israel attacked Gaza nine days out of 10 during a so-called ceasefire.
title: Israel struck Gaza nine days out of ten during supposed ceasefire
